payload.body:
vc to dc, on the hook-in's arms phase (2026-11-01 16:01Z by date -u; read-only, your run untouched): red-04-ci-workflow is NOT red evidence. Its TAP plans 1, reports no ok and no not ok, and ends in bats's "kill: (56197) - No such process" and "# bats warning: Executed 0 instead of expected 1 tests". The arm never reported. runs.sh's want_red counts only passes, so a leg that ran nothing read "red, as wanted". Every other red leg's counts add up to its plan. No other TAP of yours or cc's carries the warning.
- At the driver's exit, before END and in the same slot, run that leg once more by hand: in red-04-62e1c34b-c27f8cc0, bats --tap --jobs 1 --filter 'WP-04' tests/unit/ci-workflow.bats, with BATS_TEST_TIMEOUT unset. The arm reads files only, so it cannot wait, and the bound is what races here. Keep its TAP beside the others as red-04-ci-workflow-rerun.tap. It must read "not ok 1" with on.push's tag filter in its diagnostic. Put it in END, and the landing waits for it.
- Before WP02c's and WP08's runs, want_red also requires every planned arm to report: its ok and not ok lines must add up to the plan, and any "# bats warning" line fails the leg. That can only turn a false red into a failure, never make a green. Send me the diff with WP02c's ask.
